verdict.rationale: Discord's official discord/discord-api-spec GitHub repository publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for API v10 covering 150+ stable paths, with a separate preview spec for experimental features. However, the publication is labeled a public preview that may break without notice and is not recommended for production. The probe's 404s on docs-site OpenAPI paths only show the spec isn't hosted there; they don't contradict the GitHub publication. Missing for 10: GA/production-supported status of the spec, discoverability from the official docs site, independent hands-on corroboration of spec completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The official discord/discord-api-spec repository publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document, info title "Discord HTTP API (Preview)", API version 10, covering 150+ paths of the stable public API
